rows.en: To make up for a lack of forces, the United Space Force chose a sweep using <pic(0)><cs(3)>Gryps 2<ce()>.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: However, enemy interference is expected, so the surrounding space must be secured.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: Accordingly, <mk(0,37.5,7,3)><ar(0,7,3,150)><mk(37.5,0,7,0,50)><ar(0,7,0,150)>we will eliminate the enemy forces in the area.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: By its very nature, the firing time of the <pic(1)><cs(3)>colony laser<ce()> cannot be delayed.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: When the time comes, it will prepare to fire. Make sure the area is secure by then.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: It will be a race against time, but I believe all of you can handle it.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: The UCE and Neo Zeon have begun fighting at the Gate of Zedan. Were we too late...?
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: We managed to stop the Titans... but it means nothing if we don't make it in time.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)

rows.en: I acknowledge your efforts, but you must also accept that effort alone changes nothing.
rows.speaker: ? (briefing officer)
